concept: FSx for Lustre: file system for HPC
tests: Choosing a shared file system with sub-ms latency and high throughput for Linux HPC.
expected: Amazon FSx for Lustre — HPC/ML, sub-ms, hundreds of GB/s, S3 integration. Triggers: "high-performance computing", "sub-millisecond", "high throughput", "Linux compute nodes".
why_not: EFS — general-purpose NFS with higher latency; S3 — object storage, not POSIX; FSx for Windows — SMB for Windows.
